title: Add collapsible editor and responsive preview modes to playground
body:
Redesigned playground UI following play.tailwindcss.com aesthetic with collapsible editor panel and device-responsive preview modes (desktop/tablet/mobile).

## Changes

**Collapsible Editor Panel**
- Toggle button with smooth 300ms transitions
- LocalStorage persistence with SSR guards (`typeof window !== 'undefined'`)
- Dynamic layout adjustment (50%/50% → 0%/100%)

**Responsive Preview Modes**
- Desktop (100%), Tablet (768px), Mobile (375px) toggle controls
- Icon-based mode selector (Monitor/Tablet/Smartphone from lucide-react)
- Constrained preview containers with device frame simulation

**Visual Enhancements**
- Gradient backgrounds: `bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-white to-slate-50`
- Backdrop blur header: `bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-sm`
- Active state gradients: `bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-500`
- Enhanced Monaco editor options (smooth scrolling, cursor animations)

**Code Quality**
- Removed unused plugin imports from ObjectUIProvider (fixing module resolution errors)
- Added SSR safety checks for localStorage access
- Resolved Tailwind/inline style transition conflicts
